en.text:
Passively grants -200 Blast Radius, 25% decreased damage, and 15% decreased detonation radius.

Enemies within 6 meters of the explosion are disoriented for 4.5 seconds. Disorient radius cannot be increased using other perks.

<link Champions and Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] /> are unaffected by Disorient.

(Disorient is effectively the equivalent of <arc/>Arc Blind without any of the elemental synergies and anti-champion benefits)

Players near the explosion briefly lose their HUD and have their screen distorted for up to ? seconds. Duration varies depending on the distance from the blast.
